galar_departure_from_alola: Your Island Challenge victory and League win made global headlines.
A letter arrives on official Macro Cosmos stationery — from Leon himself.
'Heard about your trials, champion. The Galar Championship Cup needs someone like you.'
'Consider this your personal invitation. Come show the world what you've got.'
Mom: 'Galar! Rolling green hills, ancient stadiums, Pokémon roaming wild everywhere!'
Mom: 'Your Alola prize money secured us a lovely farmhouse in Postwick. All packed!'
galar_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Welcome home to Postwick! Can you believe this view?
I used your Alola Championship winnings to buy this farmhouse.
The neighbors — Hop's family — are wonderful. Such lively boys.
Go have your big adventure, dear. I'll be here enjoying the countryside!
galar_mom_home_2: Mom: Oh, {player_name}! I've been watching the Championship Cup on TV!
You know, I've now lived in Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, and now Galar!
Each home is special. But honestly? With your prize money, I could buy a different home each year.
Maybe I will. Don't tell me I can't — I'm living the dream!
galar_mom_home_3: Mom: The Wooloo from next door wandered into the garden again.
I didn't mind. They're so fluffy! Is that a Galar thing?
Oh — Sonia stopped by. She says Leon is doing well as Champion.
Or WAS doing well! Now you're going to challenge him, aren't you?
galar_leon_intro: Leon: Oi! You must be the trainer everyone's talking about!
I'm Leon — undefeated Champion of the Galar region!
Champion time! Here's an invitation to the Championship Cup.
Come find me at Wyndon Stadium when you've got all eight badges.
Let's make it the best battle Galar's ever seen!
galar_hop_intro: {rival_name}: Oi, {player_name}! My brother's the Champion — so I'm gonna be Champion too!
Battle me! I've been training all morning, and I want to see how good you are.
Let's go! This is gonna be brilliant!
galar_hop_won: I lost — but now I know what I'm working towards. Watch out, {player_name}!
galar_hop_lost: {rival_name}: LEE would be proud of me right now!
I've gotten strong! Come find me in the Wild Area — I'll keep training!
galar_sonia_intro: Sonia: Oh! Are you a new trainer? I'm Sonia — Professor Magnolia's granddaughter.
I'm researching the legend of Zacian and Zamazenta — the legendary Pokémon of Galar.
And... okay, I'm also trying to figure out what Dynamax actually is. No big deal.
Come find me in Motostoke if you learn anything interesting!
galar_oleana_intro: Oleana: Mr. Rose sends his compliments.
I am Oleana — Vice President of Macro Cosmos.
We power Galar. Literally — our energy grid keeps the lights on.
Please do not interfere with our operations. That is... a polite request.
galar_rose_intro: Rose: Ah! Our newest Championship challenger!
I'm Rose — Chairman of the Galar Pokémon League and CEO of Macro Cosmos.
I've watched your matches. You have tremendous potential.
Come speak with me at Wyndon if you make it to the finals.
galar_rose_villain: Rose: The energy crisis won't wait a thousand years.
Eternatus can generate limitless energy. I'm simply... accelerating the timeline.
The Darkest Day will be brief. The energy will last forever.
A small cost for Galar's eternal prosperity — wouldn't you agree?
galar_zacian_encounter: A legendary sword materializes from the Slumbering Weald's mist...
Zacian — the Warrior Pokémon — holds a rusted blade in its mouth.
Its eyes carry the weight of an ancient battle. It has been waiting for a worthy trainer.
galar_zamazenta_encounter: A legendary shield rises from the Slumbering Weald's fog...
Zamazenta — the Warrior Pokémon — its rusted shield form gleams dully.
A guardian born in the same ancient battle as Zacian. It chooses to stand beside you.
galar_eternatus_encounter: The tower shakes as something tears through the roof of the Energy Plant!
An alien Pokémon — ancient beyond measure — unfurls its colossal body.
Eternatus! The Gigantic Pokémon that fell from space 20,000 years ago has awakened!
galar_leon_champion: Leon: You made it. You actually made it to the top!
I've beaten everyone who's stepped into this stadium.
But I've never faced someone like you.
Champion time — let's have ourselves an absolute banger of a battle!
galar_leon_won: Leon: ...Haha. You know what? That was incredible.
I lost. Properly lost! I can't remember the last time that happened.
You are the new Galar Champion, {player_name}. Champion time — it's YOUR time now!
Take care of this place. Galar deserves a champion as brilliant as you.
galar_departure_to_paldea: Your Galar Championship broadcasts reached every corner of the world.
A letter arrives with the seal of Naranja/Uva Academy — Paldea's most prestigious school.
'We extend a full scholarship to the exceptional trainer known as {player_name}.'
'Explore Paldea at your own pace — three great paths await you.'
Mom: 'Paldea! Enormous open grasslands, real Pokémon living wild everywhere!'
Mom: 'The Galar Championship prize was extraordinary — I bought us a home right by the academy in Cabo Poco.'
galar_newgame_intro: Fluffy Wooloo graze on the hills outside your home in Postwick.
Your neighbor {rival_name} bangs on the door. His big brother Leon, the Champion, is coming home today!
{rival_name}: {player_name}! Leon's bringing presents. Come on, let's go meet him!
galar_leon_starter_intro: Leon: So you're Hop's friend! Brilliant to meet you, {player_name}!
Leon: I've brought three Pokémon. Pick a partner and we'll get you started!
Leon: Choose the one that feels right. That's the first step to a champion time!
galar_leon_starter: Leon: Great pick! You two are going to be an amazing team.
Leon: Here's a Pokédex too. Now let's see you and {rival_name} have your very first battle!
galar_mom_newstart_1: Mom: The Wooloo got into the garden again. They're too fluffy to be mad at!
Mom: Hop's family invited us for tea. Such lovely neighbors.
galar_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Gym battles here are in giant stadiums with crowds and TV cameras!
Mom: Every bit of prize money you send home goes in the 'future home' jar.
galar_mom_newstart_3: Mom: The Slumbering Weald is spooky. Please don't go in there alone.
Mom: ...Unless you're with a strong Pokémon. Then it's probably fine.

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours across the floor...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Galar
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Leon gave you an invitation to the Galar Championship Cup! Register at Motostoke and start collecting badges.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Grass, Water, Fire
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Earn the first three badges from Milo (Grass), Nessa (Water), and Kabu (Fire).

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mainland Gyms
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Bea/Allister (Fighting/Ghost) at Stow-on-Side, then Opal (Fairy) at Ballonlea.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Northern Gyms
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head to Circhester for Gordie/Melony (Rock/Ice), then confront Piers in Spikemuth (Dark).

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Raihan's Challenge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The final gym — Raihan's Dragon gym in Hammerlocke! Earn the Dragon Badge to enter the Championship Cup.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stop Chairman Rose
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Rose has activated the Darkest Day early! Stop him at Rose Tower and face Eternatus!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Champion Cup — Wyndon Stadium
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Marnie, then Hop, then Champion Leon! The whole of Galar is watching!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Hero Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: After becoming Champion, return to the Slumbering Weald. Zacian and Zamazenta await those proven worthy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wild Area
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Wild Area is home to powerful Pokémon and Max Raid Battles. Rare finds await — including Gigantamax forms!

MAX_RAID.gmax_odds_note: Each den's rarest slot (5%) is its Gigantamax species.
